Report prevalence and volume evidence

Repetition had a small measured effect on B. Exact duplicates receive shared preprocessing in every model. More bad reports do not guarantee a dramatic failure.

Limits, failure examples & human review

C still makes large errors and loses to B on many individual approaches. These buttons deliberately select recorded failure examples; they are not a representative sample.

Loading the predeclared acceptance-policy evidence…

The archive contains event timestamps; delays and corruptions here are simulated. This does not establish actual NOAA poisoning or measured receiver latency. Model C uses timestamped motion history, report age, consistency features, guarded summaries, and training with simulated degraded inputs.

Map settings

The server loads your public Mapbox token from the project's .env file automatically. A token entered here temporarily overrides it for this page. The renderer receives delivered positions and, when inspection is enabled, their original archive positions. ETA computation stays in Python.
